description: Lethilion wears a long deep plum-brown noble coat with narrow gold woven geometric borders at the collar, shoulders, front edges, cuffs and hem. An ivory linen tunic underneath has a gold-trimmed split neckline, embroidered cuffs and lower hem. A decorated woven belt with a large round bronze clasp secures the waist and has a short hanging end. Dark trousers tuck into tall brown leather boots. Both hands rest at his sides and both boots are fully visible. The opaque layers are refined and restrained, with no headgear, armor or weapon.
